dct_description_sm: Equality, Security and Community Survey is a national study exploring the economic, social and political factors that shape public policy, and how these policies determine societal values, attitudes and well-being among individuals and communities. The first wave of the Equality Security Community Survey was conducted in 1999-2000. The second wave of the Equality Security Community Survey was conducted in 2002-2003. It is a nationally-representative telephone survey combining questions on labour economics, social capital, associational memberships, and policy preferences.
dct_title_s: Equality, Security and Community Survey - Wave 1&2, 1999-2003 [Canada]
